description: The sglang modules the scheduler's own files import (python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler*.py and managers/scheduler_components/*.py) that are not decision modules, each with the reason. oracle/check_modules.py fails on an imported module that neither oracle/harness.json's decision_prefixes nor this list covers, and on an entry that names no module at the pinned commit. A module both cover is a decision module.

GPU kernels; the forward pass they serve is replaced (gpu)
model layers and their kernels, reached only through the forward pass (gpu); layers.dp_attention is a decision prefix
the model runner and its graph, buffer and loader set-up (gpu); pool_configurator and forward_batch_info are decision prefixes
the process groups and collectives of tensor and data parallelism (transport)
elastic expert-parallel membership (transport); refused by name until modelled
expert placement load balancing, read by the forward pass (gpu)
platform back ends other than CUDA (MLX, NPU); not reached on the platforms BLIS simulates
not_decision.sglang.srt.plugins: plugin loading; a plugin is an externally loaded surface item, refused by name
the embedded Rust front end (outside service)
SGLang's scripted test runtime, enabled only by its test environment variables
the model configuration, read as input
not_decision.sglang.srt.runtime_context: the published runtime context of ServerArgs values, read as input
not_decision.sglang.srt.utils: shared utilities: device memory queries (platform), sockets (transport), timers, profiling
reasoning-text parsing of outputs, with skip_tokenizer_init off; not a scheduling decision
captures of routed experts and indexer top-k for outputs
not_decision.sglang.srt.managers.auxiliary_output: auxiliary output tensors of the forward pass (gpu)
not_decision.sglang.srt.managers.load_snapshot: load snapshots published to the router (transport)
not_decision.sglang.srt.managers.mm_utils: multimodal inputs; BLIS simulates text serving
not_decision.sglang.srt.managers.multimodal_processor: multimodal inputs; BLIS simulates text serving
not_decision.sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_components: flushes buffered output to the sockets (transport)
sleeps on the sockets when idle (transport)
pool invariant checks and the watchdog; they decide nothing, and only end the process on a violation
